capabilities: Render a Gantt timeline inside an ordinary note
Create, move and resize bars by dragging
Group bars into coloured, collapsible, reorderable lanes
Edit bar title, dates, colour, progress and a linked note
Store the chart as one JSON object per line for small diffs
extras: Written with AI assistance (Claude); Android touch gestures are newer and less tested; no read-only preview when the note is embedded or shown in Reading view; the plugin makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to lay out work on a timeline, and chart images or canvas files do not diff or sync cleanly as text.

relations.evidence: Plain-text storage that syncs cleanly with Remotely Save (WebDAV, S3, …)
Add this repository in the BRAT plugin.

summary: Gantt timeline rendered inside a Markdown note, with draggable bars, lanes and per-bar notes stored as plain text.
